AUTTAINE BRAWLER/ROGUE
CR 5

Auttaine brawler 3/rogue 3
N Medium humanoid (half-construct, human)
Init +6; Senses Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 13, flat-footed 13 (+2 armor, +2 Dex, +1 dodge, +1 natural armor)
hp 43 each (6 HD; 3d8+3d10+9)
Fort +5, Ref +8, Will +1; +2 bonus vs. disease, mind-affecting effects, poison, and effects that cause either exhaustion or fatigue.
Defensive Abilities evasion, trap sense +1; Resist construct resistances

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee scizore +2 (1d10+3) or scizore flurry of blows +6/+6 (1d10+3) or unarmed strike +8 (1d6+3) or unarmed strike flurry of blows +6/+6 (1d6+3)
Ranged masterwork heavy crossbow +8 (1d10, incendiary bolt/19–20) and Special Attacks brawler’s flurry, breath weapon (1/day: acid—15 ft. cone, 2d6 (DC 13), maneuver training (grapple +1), martial flexibility 4/day, sneak attack +2d6 +2 bleed

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 15, Con 13, Int 9, Wis 9, Cha 10
Base Atk +5; CMB +8 (+9 grapple); CMD 21 (22 vs. grapple)
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Improved Unarmed Strike, Mobility, Power Attack
Skills Bluff +5, Climb +12, Intimidate +9, Knowledge (local) +4, Perception +8, Stealth +11
Languages Common
SQ brawler’s cunning, build points (5—, breath weapon (extra damage), natural armor, hidden storage compartment), martial training, rogue talent (bleeding attack +2), trapfinding +1
Gear Heavy, dirty clothes, plague-mask, leather armor, 25 gp in sundry dirty coins, incendiary bolts (10) in storage compartment, masterwork heavy crossbow, scizore
